issues.description: Downloaded music sometimes fails to appear or play offline, or the app incorrectly reports that the user is offline.
Examples mix unwanted recommendations or autoplay, limited song selection, and dissatisfaction with the algorithm or home page.
Users report that songs or complete albums, including local artists' releases, are missing or cannot be found in the catalog.
issues.issue_name: Songs or albums missing from catalog

issues.description: Lyrics fail to appear or load for songs where users expect them to be available.
Users report that lyrics have stopped appearing for some or many songs, sometimes after an update or despite troubleshooting.
